description: This file defines template classes for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) channels, including client and server types, with methods for managing connections, factories, and message invocation. It also includes class templates for handling IPC communication over sockets, with support for internal and external factory creation, connection management, and client handling within a namespace.

classes.name: IPCChannelClientType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC client channel, supporting connection management, factory creation/destruction, and state handling for IPC over sockets.

classes.name: IPCChannelServerType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC server channel, managing client connections, message invocation, and factory handling, with support for internal and external factories.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the IPC channel or socket/listener with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel or socket/listener with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel or socket is currently open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel or socket is currently closed.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for IPC elements with an initial size.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Destroys the factory for IPC elements.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a command on the IPC clients or server with a wait time.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up client connections, closing and removing closed clients.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an IPC server handler with a specific ID.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an IPC server handler by ID.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a provided action to all clients.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds a client matching a specific condition.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a new incoming socket connection and creates a client link.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes for the socket, including error handling and connection management.

methods.name: InternalCleanup
methods.description: Removes clients that are closed and cleans up handlers.

methods.name: CloseClients
methods.description: Closes all client connections and waits for them to close.

methods.name: CallRecursive
methods.description: Recursively calls clients to invoke a command, handling errors and propagation.
